_note: Student term dates by state, for the school zone speed signs ('SCHOOL DAYS'). A date inside a term, on a weekday that is not a public holiday, is a school day. A state or year not listed here is unknown: the app then shows the plain speed sign and does not guess. Add a year when the state publishes it.

NSW.source: https://education.nsw.gov.au/schooling/calendars (public schools, Eastern division; the Western division starts Term 1 a week later: 2026-02-09, 2027-02-10)
